idea: Go as deep as possible along one path, then back up and try the next branch, using a stack (or recursion). It records when each node is found and finished.
useWhen: Finding connected components, cycles or a topological order
Exploring every possibility, as in mazes and puzzles
You do not care which route is shortest
avoidWhen: You need the shortest route in edges (use BFS)
The graph is very deep and recursion could overflow
